errors.text_span: 总体来看，所有“无”刻板印象的柱状图均高于“有”刻板印象的柱状图，且“无”刻板印象的频次在仇恨程度1级时达到最高，随后在2级和3级略有下降，4级有所回升。
errors.evidence: The generation prompt explicitly instructs the model to "avoid making inferences, comparisons, or drawing conclusions from the data." This sentence violates that rule by comparing the values of the two categories ("无" is always higher than "有") and describing a trend across the x-axis categories (highest at level 1, then a drop, then a rebound).
